title: Marc Lore's Wonder files confidentially for a US IPO; the company, which acquired Grubhub for $650M in 2025, raised $650M at a $9B pre-money valuation in July (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Marc Lore's Wonder files confidentially for a US IPO; the company, which acquired Grubhub for $650M in 2025, raised $650M at a $9B pre-money valuation in July — Wonder Group, a food-delivery startup led by former Walmart executive Marc Lore, said on Thursday it had confidentially filed for a US IPO …
